d:
Hemant Soren Special Assembly Session Jharkhand : jharkhand men khanij ke adhikar ko lekar siyasi sangram tej ho gaya hai. hemant soren sarkar ne MMDR aur SIR ke mudde par 25 aur 26 navanbar ko vidhanasbha ka vishesh satr bulaya hai. is dauran kendr sarkar ke phaisle ke khilaph prastav lane ki taiyari hai.
Vahin, BJP ne sarkar ke kadam par saval uthae hain. vipaksh ka kahna hai ki agar sarkar ko rajy ke hak aur adhikar ki itni chinta hai, to avaidh khanan, balu aur koyle ki kathit lut jaise muddon par charcha kyon nahin ho rahi hai?
